entities.name: sl-MeasId
entities.description: Identifier for sidelink measurement configuration included in sl-MeasIdList within VarMeasConfigSL.

entities.name: sl-ReportType sl-EventTriggered
entities.description: Condition where reporting type is set to event-triggered for sidelink measurements.

entities.name: sl-ReportType sl-Periodical
entities.description: Condition where reporting type is set to periodical for sidelink measurements.

entities.name: Event entry condition fulfilled
entities.description: Condition where the entry condition for the event corresponding to sl-EventId is fulfilled for NR sidelink frequency after layer 3 filtering during sl-TimeToTrigger.

entities.name: Event leaving condition fulfilled
entities.description: Condition where the leaving condition for the event is fulfilled for NR sidelink frequency in sl-FrequencyTriggeredList after layer 3 filtering during sl-TimeToTrigger.

entities.name: sl-FrequencyTriggeredList empty
entities.description: Condition where the sl-FrequencyTriggeredList for a sl-MeasId becomes empty.

entities.name: sl-ReportOnLeave set to true
entities.description: Condition where sl-ReportOnLeave is set to true in the corresponding reporting configuration.

entities.name: NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated to report NR sidelink measurements, as specified in clause 5.8.10.5.

entities.name: Periodical reporting timer
entities.description: Timer associated with a sl-MeasId for periodical reporting.

entities.name: VarMeasReportListSL
entities.description: List containing NR sidelink measurement reporting entries and associated data like sl-NumberOfReportsSent and sl-FrequencyTriggeredList.

relations.description: Fulfillment of event entry condition triggers initiation of NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure.
Fulfillment of event leaving condition and sl-ReportOnLeave true triggers initiation of NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure.
Periodical reporting type and available measurement result trigger initiation of NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure.
Expiry of periodical reporting timer triggers initiation of NR sidelink measurement reporting procedure.
Fulfillment of event leaving condition and empty sl-FrequencyTriggeredList stops the periodical reporting timer.
sl-MeasId is associated with entries and data in VarMeasReportListSL.
